evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage cards (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) and the counter reads "共 8 个非遗项目", matching the visible card count.

All 8 cards carry one of the four supported category badges: 传统工艺 (Traditional Crafts) x2, 传统表演 (Performing Arts) x2, 民俗活动 (Folk Activities) x2, 传统美术 (Traditional Art) x2. No unsupported category observed.
Each card shows title (e.g. 苏绣), category badge (传统工艺), region/province line (江苏 · 江南水乡) and a brief description, plus a 了解详情 link.

Search "京剧" → 共 1 个非遗项目 (京剧). Category 传统工艺 → 共 2 (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂). Region 江苏 → 共 3 (昆曲, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂). Sort 按年份 reordered to 昆曲,苏绣,宜兴紫砂,春节,端午龙舟,剪纸,书法,京剧; sort 按地区 reordered to 安徽,北京,北京,广东,江苏x3,陕西. Count updates with every change.

/heritage/suzhou-embroidery shows title 苏绣 / Suzhou Embroidery, category badge 传统工艺, region 江苏 · 江南水乡, inclusion year "2006年入选", a full multi-sentence introduction, and a gallery of 3 thumbnails with a large main image.

苏绣 gallery has 3 thumbnails. Clicking thumb 2 (whose source fails) moved the active ring to index 1 and the main area rendered the explicit failure state "图片加载失败". Clicking thumb 3 moved the ring to index 2 and the main image updated to alt "苏绣 - 3" (photo-1558618666..., naturalWidth 800).

Set search="苏", category=传统工艺, sort=按地区 (共 1 个非遗项目, 苏绣), opened /heritage/suzhou-embroidery, then returned via breadcrumb. On return all three controls still read 传统工艺 / 全部地区 / 按地区, the search box still contains "苏", and the list still shows 共 1 个非遗项目 (苏绣).

issue: Category-browsing navigation link is a bare hash anchor and does not leave the detail page
actual: On /heritage/suzhou-embroidery the header nav item "分类浏览" (Category Browsing) has href="#categories" instead of "/#categories". Clicking it changed the URL to http://localhost:6063/heritage/suzhou-embroidery#categories while the page remained the 苏绣 detail page (main h1 = "苏绣", no #categories section present, 0 heritage cards rendered). The four footer category links (传统工艺/传统表演/民俗活动/传统美术) share the same href="#categories" defect. Only the breadcrumb "非遗项目" and the "浏览更多项目" button (href="/#categories") correctly return to the homepage list.

evidence: All 8 cards use distinct image sources (no duplicates across items) and each img alt exactly matches its item title (书法, 京剧, 春节, 端午龙舟, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂, 昆曲, 剪纸). The 苏绣 detail gallery images are alt-labelled "苏绣 - 1/-3" and are item-specific, not shared with other entries. No mismatch between image labelling and item name/description detectable via DOM.

Valid link /heritage/suzhou-embroidery opened the matching 苏绣 item. Invalid /heritage/not-a-real-project-xyz rendered only "未找到该非遗项目" plus a "返回首页" link to "/", with no heritage title, gallery or description of any other project; clicking the link returned to the homepage.

Clicking the 京剧 hotspot opened an overlay containing category badge 传统表演, title 京剧 / Peking Opera, region 北京 · 京城古韵, year 2010年入选, brief description, 3 loaded images (alt 京剧 1/2/3, naturalWidth 800), a 查看详情 link to /heritage/peking-opera, and a 继续探索 dismiss button.

issue: Hotspot overlay is mispositioned and its "View Details" / dismiss actions are rendered outside the viewport, so the overlay is not usable
actual: Clicking the 京剧 hotspot renders overlay content with the correct data (category 传统表演, title 京剧/Peking Opera, region 北京 · 京城古韵, 2010年入选, description, 3 loaded images, 查看详情 link to /heritage/peking-opera). However .overlay-content carries the Tailwind centering classes "top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" while an inline style transform:scale(1.00158) overrides them, so the panel is anchored at the viewport centre instead of centred on it: its rect is x=639,y=360,w=673,h=577 in a 1280x720 viewport. Consequently the 查看详情 link sits at y=864-912 and the 继续探索 button at y=864, both fully below the 720px viewport. The panel is overflow:hidden with scrollHeight 720 > clientHeight 576, so the actions cannot be scrolled into view. Playwright click on 继续探索 timed out with "element is outside of the viewport".

issue: Panorama yaw is unbounded and never wraps at 360 degrees; hotspots exist only in a narrow band and are permanently lost once the user rotates past it
actual: The panorama layer transform exposes yaw as translateX. Dragging horizontally moves it linearly and without limit: 24 successive left drags took it from 105px to 1185px, and 60 successive right drags took it from 1185px down to -1515px, with no modulo/wrap back to the start. Hotspots render only while translateX is roughly between +105px and -120px: across the 60-step sweep only 6 steps showed any hotspot (tx=105 →书法; 60 →剪纸,昆曲,书法; 15 →苏绣,京剧,剪纸,昆曲; -30 →苏绣,京剧,端午,宜兴; -75 →端午,宜兴,春节; -120 →春节). At every other position 0 hotspots were in the DOM. Rotating "a full 360 degrees" therefore scrolls into permanently empty space instead of wrapping around to the hotspots again.

evidence: Set camera to scale(1.4) rotateX(1.44deg) translateX(12px) via zoom-in clicks plus a drag, opened the 苏绣 overlay and followed 查看详情 to /heritage/suzhou-embroidery, then returned via 返回全景探索. On return the panorama layer transform read exactly scale(1.4) rotateX(1.44deg) translateX(12px) both immediately and after 4s, the same hotspots (苏绣, 昆曲) were visible, and the 苏绣 overlay was also restored.
